item.title: Modifiers
item.description:
Modifiers #

The GM can incorporate any of the following rules adjustments to suit their campaign:

  • Custom Stats: The GM can optionally create additional stats or edit existing ones to fit the game’s setting. When creating your character, ask the GM what stats they have selected. If using more than eight stats, select more stats to have 3◆ when creating a character. Example additional stats include Magic, Psionics, Luck, Sanity, Monster Training, Humanity, etc.

item.title: Side Sheets
item.description:
Side Sheets #

If the narrative includes an entity such as a character, pet, sidekick, or organization that is important enough to warrant its own character sheet, then the GM can choose to create a side sheet for that entity, either using default stats or adjusting them to their liking.

Side sheets are character sheets that do use stress or have their own experience points. When creating a side sheet, determine which players are its owners. The side sheet’s owners can control the entity, roleplay as it, decide its actions, and make rolls with it.
